Annapurna Rasoi — Wedding Catering, Pune

Annapurna Rasoi is a Pune caterer offering Maharashtrian and multi-cuisine
wedding menus, with a reputation for consistent quality and reliable service at
mid-range pricing.

Their standard vegetarian package is ₹1,100 per plate; non-vegetarian menus
start at ₹1,350 per plate. Dessert and live counters can be added on request.

Contact: +91 90280 44551 · contact@annapurnarasoi.example
Location: Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (176 reviews)
